title: DrunkCraft - The Game
description: Turns minecraft into a drinking game
body:
# 🥴 DrunkCraft v2.2.0
**Minecraft:** Paper / Spigot 1.20.4 +  
**Author:** Ayo  

---

## 🍺 What is DrunkCraft?
DrunkCraft turns your Minecraft world into a chaotic drinking game — random, funny, and slightly dangerous for your liver.  
Every time you mine, craft, die, or even sneeze, there’s a chance someone has to **take a drink or a shot**.  

Perfect for chill nights with friends or chaotic solo runs.

---

## 🧠 How It Works
The plugin listens for **Minecraft events** (mining, crafting, killing, etc.) and randomly picks who drinks.

- **Drink** = +1 point  
- **Finish your drink** = +2 points  
- **Shot** = +3 points  

A live **scoreboard** on the right side tracks everyone’s total.  
Everything can be customized in `config.yml`.

---

## 🍻 Event List + Probabilities

### 🧍 Self Triggers (affect only the player)
| Event | Description | Chance |
|:------|:-------------|:-------|
| Eats food | “Energized sip” | **5 %** |
| Places bed in Nether/End | Boom → finish drink | **100 %** |
| Enchants an item | “Arcane burnout” | **10 %** |
| Brews a potion | “Chemistry tax” | **15 %** |
| Smelts ore | “Hydration timer” | **8 %** |
| Uses ender pearl | “Pearl dehydration penalty” | **12 %** |
| Takes 4 + hearts fall damage | “Ouch tax” | **25 %** |
| Breaks a tool | “Warranty expired” | **100 %** |
| Dies | Finish your drink | **100 %** |
| Survives 10 min without dying | “Hydration checkpoint” | **timer event** |

---

### 🎲 Random Player Triggers
| Event | Description | Chance |
|:------|:-------------|:-------|
| Mines Diamond Ore | Everyone drinks except miner | **25 %** |
| Mines Emerald Ore | Random player drinks | **7.5 %** |
| Mines Gold Ore | Random player drinks | **7.5 %** |
| Mines Iron Ore | Random player drinks | **4 %** |
| Mines Coal Ore | Random player drinks | **3 %** |
| Breaks Obsidian | Miner drinks | **5 %** |
| Sleeps in bed | Random player drinks | **20 %** |
| Fishes item | Random player takes shot | **15 %** |
| Opens loot chest | Random player drinks | **18 %** |
| Tames animal | Random player drinks | **10 %** |

---

### 🌍 Global / Everyone Events
| Event | Description | Chance |
|:------|:-------------|:-------|
| Weather → rain | Everyone drinks (“Hydration weather”) | **100 %** |
| Weather → clear | Everyone rests | **100 %** |
| Rings bell | Everyone drinks | **25 %** |
| Raid starts | Everyone drinks (“Pre-battle buff”) | **100 %** |
| Raid ends | Everyone finishes drink | **100 %** |
| Hits level 30 | Everyone drinks | **100 %** |
| Enters Nether | Everyone drinks | **100 %** |
| Finds Nether Fortress | Everyone drinks | **100 %** |
| Finds Stronghold | Everyone drinks | **100 %** |
| Finds Mushroom biome | Everyone except explorer drinks | **100 %** |
| First villager trade | Everyone drinks | **100 %** |
| Kills Ender Dragon | Everyone takes shot | **100 %** |
| Finds The End | Everyone takes shot | **100 %** |
| Gets Elytra | Everyone except that player drinks | **100 %** |
| Full Diamond armor | Everyone except that player drinks | **100 %** |
| Full Netherite armor | Everyone except that player takes shot | **100 %** |
| First Ancient Debris | Random player takes shot | **100 %** |
| First Return to Sender | Random player takes shot | **100 %** |

---

## 🧾 Commands
| Command | Description |
|:---------|:-------------|
| `/drunkcraft reload` | Reloads config + data |
| `/drunkcraft reset` | Clears first-time flags and leaderboard |

---

## 🧩 Permissions
| Permission | Description | Default |
|:------------|:-------------|:---------|
| `drunkcraft.admin` | Allows `/drunkcraft` commands | OP |

---

## 🧃 Scoreboard System
| Action | Points |
|:-------|:--------|
| Drink | +1 |
| Finish Drink | +2 |
| Shot | +3 |

Displayed on the sidebar and updates live for all players.

---

## 💬 Example Messages
> **\<DrinkingCraft\>** Steve mined gold and to avoid tax evasion picked Alex to drink 💸  
> **\<DrinkingCraft\>** CowSlayer fell 20 blocks — Ouch tax, sip.  
> **\<DrinkingCraft\>** RIP Noob123 — Finish your drink!  
> **\<DrinkingCraft\>** The End discovered — Everyone takes a SHOT!  

---

## ⚙️ Configuration
All values editable in `plugins/DrunkCraft/config.yml`:
- Drink / shot percentages  
- Quirky messages  
- Title texts & sounds  
- Score weights  
- Timer intervals  

Reload without restart using: `/drunkcraft reload`.

---

## 🧠 Compatibility
- Built for **Paper 1.20.4**  
- Works fine on **1.21 +**  
- Should run on Spigot (but Paper recommended)
